ITEM 1 | Strawberry halves and slices, bright red with white core and pale seed pattern, glossy and moist, cut into wedges and fan-like slices, roughly 2-3 cm each, clustered at upper-center of plate | 45
ITEM 2 | Whole blueberries, dark blue-purple with slight bloom and matte skin, three to four small berries about 1 cm across, grouped near the strawberries at top | 5
ITEM 3 | Blackberries, dark purple-black drupelet clusters with glossy surfaces, two to three berries about 2 cm across, placed at right edge beside the grain mound | 12
ITEM 4 | Pale grey-white grain mound with slightly granular, crumbly texture, matte and dry-looking, spread about 6 x 5 cm and roughly 1 cm high, sitting at right side of plate next to blackberries | 60
ITEM 5 | Small pinkish-red smear and specks of juice on the white plate surface below the strawberries, thin and watery, barely visible | 3
